name: CBK Licensed Foreign Exchange Bureaus
source: Central Bank of Kenya - Directory of Licenced Foreign Exchange Bureaus as at September 30, 2026
notes: The as_of date comes from the document title/filename. Rows were parsed from PDF word coordinates, 96 entries numbered 1-96. The directory gives no licence numbers. Location = premises as given. Date of licencing is in notes. A superscript artifact 'th 20 Century' was fixed to '20th Century' (Peaktop, Sky).
